stories.headline: They Have Come Back: the Jeep Returns With Mud Past the Running Boards, a Third Mark on the Chart, and One Thing Nobody Expected
stories.byline: By our Harlan's Hollow correspondent, filing from the kitchen table
body: At fourteen minutes past two this afternoon, the enchanted Jeep crossed back through the hollow's mouth, climbed the access road without hesitation, and rolled to a halt in front of the house with the particular satisfied engine-tick of a vehicle that has done what it set out to do. The mud reached past both running boards. Steve was already talking before he had the door fully open. Christine had the chart unfolded against the bonnet before the engine had cooled.

The creek crossing — subject of three weeks of preparation, one revised depth annotation, a recovery rope, a hand-winch, and the better part of one man's Wednesday opinions at the Jellico feed-supply counter — was navigated without incident at nine seventeen. Christine had the line right. Steve took it at the angle she specified. The winch was not deployed. It was, sources confirm, ready.

The third mark on the chart sits half a mile above the second circle, on a ridge the older maps call nothing and the newer maps do not call at all. Steve has written four words in the margin this time. Christine has already looked up the elevation. The one thing nobody expected has not yet been disclosed to the Ministry, to the goblins, or to this correspondent — but it was carried home in a coat pocket and placed on the kitchen table, where it joins the chart, the trail guide, the annotated road notes, and the duck, which was found at the second waymarker facing due south, which is not the direction it was left.

stories.headline: Gringotts Files Weekly Summary; Notes That the Week Ran Well; Attributes This to One Person; Spells Her Name Correctly for the First Time
body: The weekly account summary submitted by Gringotts Bank to the Ministry of Magic this Friday afternoon contained, on its fourth page, a notation that has not previously appeared in seventeen years of weekly summaries: a correctly spelled acknowledgment of Senior Client Liaison Christine, whose name has been rendered in goblin ledger-script as 'Christeen,' 'Krissteen,' and, on one notable occasion in the spring of last year, simply a rune meaning 'the one who comes on Tuesdays.'

The Head Liaison Office declined to comment. Griphook the Younger, reached in the east vault corridor, confirmed only that 'the ledger is what the ledger is,' and walked away at a pace that those familiar with goblins would describe as flustered.

stories.headline: House Stood During Absence; Inventory Inconclusive; the Biscuit Tin Has Moved Approximately Eight Inches and No One Is Saying Why
body: A full governance review of the household, conducted upon Christine and Steve's return at fourteen fourteen, found the premises structurally intact, all doors on their hinges, and three familiars in positions consistent with their known characters: Lucy in the kitchen, Ellie on the sofa apparently awaiting her own return, and Jersey in the warmest available patch of afternoon sun, undisturbed by the entire weekend.

The biscuit tin, last verified at its standard position on the second shelf at six thirty-eight this morning, was found upon return to have traveled eight and one quarter inches to the left. There are no witnesses. There is no evidence. There is, however, a Lucy, and this is considered sufficient context for the record, if not for prosecution.

stories.headline: Ministry Issues Return-Day Bulletin; Confirms the Jeep Has Come Back; Requests Formal Report on the Creek; Asks About the Duck's Reorientation; Notes That None of This Is in the Regulations
body: The Department of Magical Expeditions and Unregistered Hollows issued a special Saturday bulletin this afternoon upon receiving confirmation that the Jellico expedition had concluded and the party had returned safely. The bulletin, running to eleven paragraphs, devoted four of them to the duck.

The Ministry has formally registered its concern that a rubber duck placed facing north-northeast on a Jeep mirror in Hogsmeade was found, upon arrival at a hollow four miles north-northeast, facing due south — a reorientation the Department describes as 'navigationally significant and procedurally unprecedented.' A subcommittee has been formed. It has already asked to see the duck. The duck is on the kitchen table. No visit has been scheduled.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Spent the day conducting a thorough inventory of the kitchen, the utility room, and one shelf of the pantry that is technically unreachable; declines to characterize any of this as unsupervised access, and notes that the biscuit tin's current position is simply where it has always been.

Ellie: Greeted Christine's return with the full enthusiasm of someone who had genuinely not been certain she was coming back, despite having watched the Jeep leave only this morning; has since stationed herself six inches from Christine's left knee and considers the matter resolved.

Jersey: Assessed the afternoon sun, determined it was at its optimal angle by half past one, and occupied the warm patch on the sitting-room floor from one thirty-two until the Jeep arrived, at which point he relocated to Christine's lap without breaking what could generously be described as his momentum.
founding_editor_note: Four words in the margin this time — he's learning. When I built my first map table, I used six. You get better at knowing what counts. — D.

in_brief.sport: The recovery rope remains undeployed; the winch remains un-deployed; both have been returned to the garage with the quiet dignity of equipment that was ready and knew it.
in_brief.forecast: Clear skies through Sunday evening, with a twenty percent chance of someone looking at the chart again before dinner and pointing at the ridge.

storyline_updates.title: What the Hollow Gave Back
storyline_updates.summary: Day 2: The Jeep returned at fourteen fourteen with mud past both running boards. The creek crossing was clean at nine seventeen — Christine's line, Steve's angle, winch not deployed. A third mark now sits on the chart, half a mile above the second circle on an unnamed ridge. Steve has four margin words this time. The duck was found at the second waymarker facing due south. The one unexpected thing was carried home in a coat pocket and now sits on the kitchen table; its identity has not yet been disclosed. Day 3 should reveal what the unexpected thing is — something found on the ridge, a feature of the hollow itself, or whatever the duck's reorientation implies — and give Steve's four margin words partial meaning. The Ministry's duck subcommittee may also attempt contact.
